landing.promptLabel: Start by describing your idea in a sentence
landing.heroSub: Darb is an AI platform that helps you test a business idea before you launch. See how it could perform in the Saudi market, understand the risks, and get a clear path to setting it up.
landing.hb1: What problem does your startup solve, and who is it for?
landing.hb2: A booking app for home food businesses in Riyadh.
landing.featTitle: Everything a founder needs, on one clear path.
landing.featSub: One conversation gives you a score you can understand, the startups closest to your idea, the market around it, and the steps to launch.
landing.f1b: Darb starts by asking about your idea. Its questions adapt to your answers, so it learns your sector, your customers, your business model and anything else that matters. Everything Darb shows you afterwards is built on that conversation.
landing.cv1: What problem does your startup solve, and who is it for?
landing.cv2: A booking app for home food businesses in Riyadh.
landing.cv3: Great. Will you handle deliveries yourself or work with a delivery partner?
landing.cv4: We'll work with a delivery app.
landing.f2b: Darb gives your idea a score from 0 to 100, based on the idea itself and its market. It also shows what pushed the score up and what pulled it down, so you can see your strengths, your risks and what needs more thought.
landing.gaugeNote: Based on your idea and its market potential.
landing.f3b: Darb finds the Saudi startups closest to your idea, so you can see what they offer, where they operate and how far they have come.
landing.b1: Describe your idea in Arabic or English. Darb asks only for what it still needs to know.
landing.b2: One score from 0 to 100, with what raised it and what lowered it.
landing.b3: The Saudi startups closest to your idea, with their sector, location and stage.
landing.b4: Establishments, growth and jobs in your activity, from Monsha’at data.
landing.b5: The registrations and licenses you need, in order, each with the authority responsible for it.
landing.b6: Your whole assessment in one report that you can save as a PDF.
landing.f5b: Darb lays out what you need to set up your business in Saudi Arabia: the registrations and licenses, in the order you need them, each with the authority responsible for it.
landing.f6b: Darb puts your whole assessment into one report. Review your results, come back to earlier assessments, and keep a clear record of your analysis and roadmap.
landing.exSub: Darb is more than an assessment. Browse the startups, the support programs and the regulations that make up the Saudi startup scene.
landing.x1b: Browse startups across Saudi Arabia by sector, region and stage, and see who is already operating in your market.
landing.x2b: Find incubators and accelerators across Saudi Arabia, and the programs that fit your sector, your stage and what you need.
landing.x3b: Look up regulatory and licensing requirements by activity and sector, with the responsible authorities, all in one place.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Darb is a graduation project at King Saud University that helps founders in Saudi Arabia test a startup idea. This page explains what information Darb collects, why, and who handles it.
privacy.collectAccount: Account details you enter when you sign up: your name, username, email, password (stored encrypted), and profile details such as region, education level and field of study.
privacy.collectGoogle: If you sign in with Google: your name, email address and profile picture from your Google account. We do not get your Google password.
privacy.collectIdeas: What you share with Darb: your startup ideas, your chat messages with Darb, and the assessments Darb prepares for you.
privacy.useText: Only to run Darb: to sign you in, to analyse your idea and reply to you in the chat, to keep your assessment history so you can return to it, and to contact you about your account (for example email confirmation and password reset).
privacy.servicesSupabase: Supabase stores your account and your data, and handles sign-in.
privacy.servicesAi: Your chat messages are sent to an AI service (OpenAI) to write Darb's replies, and parts of your idea may be used to search trusted websites (Tavily).
privacy.servicesHosting: The website and the chat server run on Render.
privacy.shareText: We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising. We only share it with the services above, so they can run Darb for you.
privacy.choicesText: You can view and edit your profile at any time. You can ask us to delete your account and all your data by emailing us, and we will do it.
privacy.contactText: For any question about your data, email:
